milestones.title: M0 — Foundation
milestones.description: Product, research, architecture, design system, contributor setup and GitHub planning.

milestones.title: M1 — Safe analysis
milestones.description: Guarded egress, public URL policy, safe metadata and capability-driven options.

milestones.title: M2 — Durable downloads
milestones.description: SQLite queue, cancellation, temporary storage, expiry and range streaming.

milestones.title: M3 — Workspace experience
milestones.description: Responsive accessible paste-to-download experience and honest states.

milestones.title: M4 — Self-hosted pre-release
milestones.description: Container isolation, operations, CI and real authorized extraction evidence.

milestones.title: M5 — Broader media coverage
milestones.description: Evaluate and implement public image/gallery coverage and locale groundwork.

issues.title: Document research, product boundary and architecture
acceptance: Compare primary upstream projects and record dated sources.
Record decisions for router, SQLite, queue, cache and local storage.
Document access policy and architectural tradeoffs as ADRs.

issues.title: Establish design system and contributor foundation
acceptance: Install/use UI UX Pro Max before UI implementation.
Document reusable tokens, responsive layout, accessibility and state transitions.
Add license, contributor/security policies, templates, CI and testing standards.

issues.title: Enforce URL and outbound network security
acceptance: Reject unsafe schemes, credentials, ports and special-use addresses.
Validate all resolved addresses and pin public destination at dial time.
Test IPv4, IPv6, mixed DNS and rebinding protections.
Prevent direct extractor egress in the supported Docker topology.

issues.title: Normalize metadata and actual format options
acceptance: Expose only safe title, source and format metadata; omit signed URLs.
Derive video/audio/subtitle/thumbnail options from real metadata.
Reject DRM/live/auth-required results and unsafe format IDs.
Support safe direct images and bounded extractor image entries; document gaps.

issues.title: Bound analysis and scope sessions
acceptance: Limit concurrent analysis, request rates, cache count and TTL.
Scope tokens to random HttpOnly sessions stored as hashes.
Cancel/deadline extraction and limit captured subprocess output.
Enforce mutation origin and JSON payload limits.

issues.title: Persist and recover the bounded job queue
acceptance: Persist jobs before acknowledging creation.
Claim work atomically and enforce global/per-owner capacity.
Restore queued jobs and explicitly fail interrupted processing after restart.
Test owner access and terminal transition races.

issues.title: Manage worker progress, cancellation and retries
acceptance: Use bounded workers and job deadlines.
Persist throttled progress without leaking raw extractor output.
Cancellation stops process descendants on Linux and releases capacity.
Retry creates a new job with safe options and fresh extraction.

issues.title: Implement safe storage, expiry and file serving
acceptance: Use generated job directories and fixed output templates.
Reject traversal, symlinks, unsafe extensions and oversized output.
Serve owner-scoped attachments with byte ranges and no buffering.
Clean expired, canceled and interrupted scratch files.

issues.title: Build the paste, analyze and selection experience
acceptance: Detect source locally and analyze only on explicit submission.
Render actual capability choices with clear quality/container labels.
Cover loading, cancel, invalid URL and upstream rejection states.
Support keyboard navigation and accessible status/error feedback.

issues.title: Build responsive jobs and download interactions
acceptance: Show durable job list with progress, cancel, retry, save and expiry.
Pause status polling in hidden tabs and recover transient connection loss.
Verify desktop/mobile reflow and reduced motion.
Use a visibly labeled deterministic fixture walkthrough without fake downloads.

issues.title: Add hardened Docker topology and operations
acceptance: Provide non-root, resource-bounded, read-only containers.
Only guarded egress process has outbound internet; no published proxy/API port.
Document config, health, shutdown, backup, quotas and public hosting requirements.
Add reproducible build and image publication workflows.

issues.title: Complete pre-release verification gates
acceptance: Run deterministic browser flow against Go fixture engine.
Test real authorized media extraction separately from fixtures.
Verify Linux process cancellation and direct network isolation.
Audit dependencies and record all unrun gates before a release tag.

issues.title: Evaluate a dedicated public gallery adapter
acceptance: Research gallery-dl public-only behavior without cookies or access bypass.
Create authorized Instagram/TikTok photo fixtures and capability coverage matrix.
Keep all outbound requests under the same proxy and item/byte limits.
Implement only if user value justifies the maintenance cost.

issues.title: Prepare locale and RTL support
acceptance: Externalize product messages.
Keep URL/file/codec fields bidi-safe.
Verify Arabic layout, labels and keyboard order.
